title: Measured score-error budget on the door3 classifier rungs and a d = 2 mixture law
statement: Measured evidence only (py/score_error_budget.py door3 and synthetic2d, 8 Sep 2026; cut-aligned QUADPACK). door3 (examples/door3_classifier.py, logistic-regression rungs 15/60/300 events per class, D-exchange rule with K = 4, rebuilt through the O6 audit's closed forms): true retention of the deployed labels 0.8937 / 0.9557 / 0.9716 against reported 0.9671 / 0.9710 / 0.9738 (log ratio 0.079 / 0.016 / 0.0023); whitened score error eps = 0.500 / 0.289 / 0.096, after the least-squares linear reduction 0.416 / 0.235 / 0.067 (uncentred correlation between true and proxy score 0.909 / 0.972 / 0.998); eps_R = 0.447 / 0.262 / 0.091; exact first-order term T_1 = 0.084 / 0.025 / 0.0028; the sharper alignment bound 0.270 / 0.079 / 0.016 covers T_1 by 3-6x, the crude first-order budget 1.89 / 1.10 / 0.37 by 24x; rule applied to the true score retains 0.947 / 0.971 / 0.973; mislabel mass pi = 0.275 / 0.186 / 0.051; both Loewner sandwiches hold (Gamma = 0.80 / 0.41 / 0.10); the margin bound is vacuous at the two larger errors and 0.45 at rung 300. synthetic2d (the O7 bounded three-component mixture, d = 2, K = 4, eta_D = 0.3303, retention eigenvalues 0.131 and 0.830): a template with all component means shifted by delta = 0.05 / 0.1 / 0.2 / 0.4 has eps = 0.072 / 0.143 / 0.285 / 0.563 and reports log ratios -0.007 / +0.003 / +0.064 / +0.263; an error of the same eps aligned with the weakest retained direction and sign-correlated with the cells reports +0.021 / +0.068 / +0.204 / +0.468 (eps_R = 0.20 / 0.39 / 0.78 / 1.54) against +0.004 / +0.009 / +0.022 / +0.052 for the strongest direction (eps_R = 0.08 / 0.17 / 0.33 / 0.66); every row lies inside the B2 bracket; T_1 <= 0.04 on every row and (eps_R^2 - eps^2)/2 reproduces the weak-direction gap to 0.01 for eps <= 0.29.
assumptions: population quantities by QUADPACK on cut-aligned pieces (epsabs 1e-14) with the door3 mixture truncated at |x| <= 15; the recorded O6/O7 values of eta_D and the proxy retention reproduce to rounding
the door3 rules are the frozen rungs of the example (deterministic seeds); the synthetic2d rule is the fixed x-cut partition of the O7 mixture; one partition per law
the adversarial proxies are constructed with the truth (direction and cell signs); they isolate the mechanism, they are not classifiers
measured, never theorem authority; no statement about other rules, other K, or refitted rules

Independent replay recorded in WORK/artifacts/AUDIT-SCORE-ERROR-BUDGET-001/replicate.json; historical affine/eps_aff labels mean zero-intercept linear least-squares reduction. Original numeric claims are compared at their published rounding precision.

proof_location.section: O8. Score-error budget for a frozen rule: what an estimated score costs, to first order

role: falsification and calibration experiment for O8.2-O8.3 on the one library example that has both a classifier and the analytic score, plus the mechanism isolation in d = 2; did not falsify, and showed which term dominates where (alignment on door3, spurious information on the synthetic law)
warning: Measured only. The door3 classifier's score error (30-50% at the small rungs) is far outside the range where the rule-transfer bound says anything; the reporting budget still brackets the gap there because the error is mostly linear and the rule nearly lossless.
